subject: How to plot average of data with missing x values

messages.author: 34edaa82dd7981e0
messages.subject: How to plot average of data with missing x values
parts:
I want to draw a plot with an average of 100 runs that I did of an algorithm and show the average improvement over time.

My data looks like this (2 runs)

x1; y1  ; x2 ; y3
1 ; 100 ; 1  ; 150
4 ; 90  ; 2  ; 85
7 ; 85  ; 10 ; 60
10; 80  ;

A big point is that I do not have y data for all each x value, so everything needs to be smoothed first I think. In order to compute the average y, at each value of x_i

My goal is to get it in a graph with smoothed ribbons. Do you think I should do a plot or a scatterplot? And if it takes the average at say x = 4, will it take into account that the value for the second run would be between 85 and 60?

I hope to accomplish this without manually putting all the values in. Perhaps I could get the smooth graph for each run and then average that? Does ggplot support this?

Thanks!


ps: I have found some code like this, but the missing x seems a problem:

require(ggplot2)  # need to install ggplot2 
plt <- ggplot(minptemp, aes(x= months))
plt + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin= Low, ymax= High), fill="yellow") + geom_line(aes(y=Mean))+
geom_point(aes(x = months, y = Prep)) + theme_bw( ) # ribbon plus point plot months

messages.author: e01d780396d5e3f0
messages.subject: Re: How to plot average of data with missing x values
parts:
Hello, 

Do you want to fill in the missing values ? If so, you can use "na.locf" function in package zoo. 

You can try this: 

# Read your sample data frame
df1 <- read.table(text="x1; y1  ; x2 ; y3

10; 80; ;  ", sep=";", header=T)

# Note missing values are assigned NA values
head(df1)

# Use zoo package
library(zoo)

# fromlast=TRUE uses the previous value to fill in the missing values
df1$x2 <- na.locf(df1$x2,fromlast=FALSE)
df1$y3 <- na.locf(df1$y3, fromlast=FALSE)


# Now you can calculate the average or any statistical parameter
# simple test

summary(df1)


This should get you going. 

Best, 
Janesh Devkota
